alkylation reagent: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA)
alkylation concentration: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA)
cleavage agent: Proteins bound to the GFP-Trap®_A beads were digested using trypsin
collision energy: HCD fragmentation with normalised collision energy of 33
enrichment method: Immunoprecipitation was performed using GFP-Trap®_A Kit (Chromotek)
fractionation method: Reversed phase chromatography was used to separate tryptic peptides prior to mass spectrometric analysis.
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation with normalised collision energy of 33
instrument: analysed on a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion (Q-OT-qIT, Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: Eluting peptides were converted to gas-phase ions by means of electrospray ionisation
labeling: Proteins bound to the GFP-Trap®_A beads were digested using trypsin and the peptides were analysed by LC-MS/MS.
mass analyzer: Tandem MS was performed by isolation at 1.2 Th using the quadrupole, HCD fragmentation with normalised collision energy of 33, and rapid scan MS analysis in the ion trap.
precursor tolerance: The dynamic exclusion duration was set to 45 s with a 10 ppm tolerance around the selected precursor and its isotopes.
ptm: carbamidomethylation of cysteines (fixed); Oxidation of methionine (variable); acetylation of the protein N-terminus (variable)

For the database search, peptides were generated from a tryptic digestion with up to two missed cleavages, carbamidomethylation of cysteines as fixed modifications. Oxidation of methionine and acetylation of the protein N-terminus were added as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA)
reduction concentration: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA)
